rationale: Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport with investigation underway; Iran threatens escalation after US strikes on oil tankers; fireworks blast kills at least 10 in Mexico.

top_events.title: Amazon cargo plane crashes in US while landing at Miami airport
top_events.label: Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
top_events.summary: Amazon Prime Air Boeing 767 overran runway at Miami International Airport and collided with vehicles. Cause under investigation; affects major cargo hub and air freight operations.

top_events.title: Iran warns of 'faster, heavier, more painful response' to US attacks
top_events.label: Iran threatens escalation after US strikes
top_events.summary: Tehran warns of stronger retaliation following US strikes on oil tankers. Direct US-Iran military engagement continues with threat of escalation affecting American forces and fuel prices.

top_events.title: At least 10 killed in central Mexico fireworks blast during festival
top_events.label: Mexico fireworks blast kills at least 10
top_events.summary: At least 10 killed and 60 wounded in blast during festival, apparently caused by burning bull effigy. Tragedy affects US neighbor and communities with cross-border ties.
